hypotheses.H1: Ceiling outsiders improve coverage in Week5, not Week4 Thursday; expanded visibility did not change the fixed selection proxy. Sunday unavailable.
hypotheses.H2: Confirmed diagnostic five-player core despite captain and thesis differences; insufficient diversification is an outcome-risk hypothesis, not established statistical fact.
hypotheses.H3: <=4 high-quality alternatives existed on both usable slates. Pure objective-cap policies had neutral best-entry outcomes on both; prospective diagnostic/attention experiment justified, no hard rule supported.
hypotheses.H4: <=3 eliminates the joint95 band on both slates but retains joint90 pairs; costly at a stringent standard, not proven universally too restrictive.

known_prior_outcomes_caveat: User supplied Week5 score/rank and earlier post-slate research already exists. This retrospective experiment cannot claim outcome-blind policy invention. The generic parameter grid is fixed before this replay's outcome joins; no adaptive tuning.

evaluation.aggregation: Only prelock_saved_run enters cross-slate counterfactual summary; late-generated slate has no replay selections
evaluation.field_rank: competition rank = 1 + number strictly greater; percentile interval from number below and at-or-below; top bands include boundary ties

pair.A_different_captains: Control constrained to different canonical CPT player IDs
pair.B_different_archetypes: Control constrained to different saved captain_archetype

pair.D_shared_le3: Control constrained to shared physical-player count <=3

E_complementarity.complementarity: unweighted average of (6-shared)/6, different captain, different primary thesis, 1-scenario Jaccard similarity; empty scenarios contribute 0
E_complementarity.individual_quality: average of both lineups' mean_fraction and ceiling_fraction (four values)
E_complementarity.score: individual_quality + lambda * complementarity; same ID tie break

pair.control: Maximum saved objective_score sum; ties sorted candidate IDs ascending; proxy has no historical exposure constraints

quality_cost.additional_question: For caps 4,3 find maximum minimum ceiling; retain candidate minima and joint-quality optima without outcome selection.
quality_cost.rule: Among feasible pairs maximize minimum of all four mean/ceiling fractions; ties average quality desc, IDs asc. Also freeze best objective pair in each joint band.

pair.universe: all distinct packet-quality-eligible canonical rosters; no new quality screen

production_preservation.scope: All existing backend runtime Python and ui/src TS/TSX/CSS files hashed before this audit. Existing files changed concurrently outside this audit's edits and are preserved. Global hash equality and audit-owned edit scope are separate checks; this audit edits only isolated scripts/tests/artifacts and documentation.

DO_NOT_CHANGE_YET: Production optimizer, candidate generation, finalist algorithm, quality thresholds, market compatibility, ownership, projections, salary or live AI Review Universe.
No player-specific exposure changes, production overlap cap, fitted weights, or three-slate statistical claim.
KEEP: Canonical identity, frozen pools, existing projection/mean/P90 calculations and quality framework.
Complete AI Review Universe, stage separation and chronology exclusions.
TEST_PROSPECTIVELY: Predeclare finalists plus top10 eligible ceiling outsiders as a shadow attention set; save actual considered and rejected IDs.
Show shared physical-player count before two-entry selection; compare <=4 alternatives with explicit mean/ceiling opportunity cost, allowing justified exceptions.
Keep <=3 as a shadow sensitivity arm; do not force it or tune complementarity weights.
